name: pgAdmin 4
description: pgAdmin 4 is the web-based administration and development platform for PostgreSQL. It browses and edits database objects, runs queries in a SQL editor with explain plans, and handles backups, restores, roles and server monitoring for any number of PostgreSQL servers.

notes.text: Run it inside an existing Debian or Ubuntu LXC (amd64 only), typically the one running PostgreSQL. pgAdmin is served at http://<IP>/pgadmin4.
The login email and a generated password are shown once at the end of the install and are not saved anywhere else.
Lost the password: run `/usr/pgadmin4/venv/bin/python3 /usr/pgadmin4/web/setup.py update-user <email> --password <new>` in the container. Saved server passwords must then be entered again.

app_vars.name: var_pgadmin_port
app_vars.label: Port
app_vars.help: Empty uses 80, or 5050 when port 80 is taken; ignored when Apache is already installed
